prose: E2B releases E2B Embed, which lets agent companies package E2B and run its sandboxes inside a customer's own environment. It brings the E2B Runtime and dashboard to a single machine the customer controls, alongside E2B Cloud and Bring Your Own Cloud. The motivation: some customers, often government organizations, require data to stay inside their environment.
highlights: E2B Embed runs sandboxes in the customer's environment
Runtime and dashboard on one controlled machine
Sits next to E2B Cloud and BYOC
Aimed at data-residency needs such as government
